answer.why: TARGET (Century Communities) is a national US homebuilder selling single-family homes, townhomes, condos and paired homes directly to residential buyers (entry-level, first-time, move-up), with affiliated mortgage (Inspire Home Loans), title (Parkway Title) and insurance (IHL) services, operating in 16 states via on-site sales staff, online channels and third-party brokers [T:P1.7, T:P2.2, T:P2.4, T:P2.5, T:P2.6, T:P2.7, T:P3.1]. COMP (Dream Finders Homes) is likewise a US homebuilder selling new construction homes to residential buyers, with on-community sales staff and affiliated financial services, emphasising customer personalisation and service [C:P1.1, C:P1.2, C:P1.5, C:P1.13, C:P2.3]. Both companies build and sell the same types of residential homes to the same B2C buyer segments, with identical ancillary mortgage/title/insurance services — a textbook direct competitor relationship.
